verdict.rationale: Sift documents Workflows as a "powerful rules automation platform" for real-time risk decisions, with custom Workflows, custom Decisions such as Ban Account or Cancel Order, and Review Queues. That covers rules on top of Sift's 0-100 and abuse-specific scores that route to block, approve or review outcomes. An old community comment from the CEO said the product had "no rules", but the current Workflows docs supersede it, so it lowers confidence rather than making this disputed. Missing for 10: any evidence that rules can use velocity counters, list matches or arbitrary transaction attributes as conditions; detail on the rule-authoring interface or condition logic; independent or hands-on corroboration of rule authoring.
